texts: From the shop to your door, in three steps.
Pick what you want, pay at the checkout, and we'll get it to you. Here's what happens along the way.
Delivery and returns, in plain words.
Everything you need to know is below.
Browse the products page and choose the things you'd like. Prices are in pounds and shown plainly.
Sign up to open the shop, add your items to the basket, and pay once at the end.
We pack your order and send it out. The delivery section below tells you how long it takes.
Delivery and returns, kept up to date by our team.
Orders arrive in 3 to 5 days. We post everything with a tracked service, Monday to Friday, and you'll get a note when your parcel is on its way. Postage is added at the checkout.
Changed your mind? Send anything back within 30 days of it arriving, unused and in its original packaging. Email us with your order number and we'll sort out a refund.
Browse the products, then head into the shop.
Sign up to open the Donkey shop and place your first order. It only takes a moment.
Everyday goods and small prices from Donkey.
